script.code: const now = new Date(); const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2,'0'); const fmt = d => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; const end = new Date(now); const start = new Date(now); start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7); return { windowStart: fmt(start), windowEnd: fmt(end) };

script.code: const response = $context.outputs.HTTP_Request_Coupa; if (!response || response.statusCode < 200 || response.statusCode >= 300) { throw new Error('Coupa query failed with status ' + (response ? response.statusCode : 'unknown')); } const invoices = response.content || []; let qualifyingCount = 0; for (const inv of invoices) { if (inv['is-credit-note'] === true) { console.log('Excluded: credit note, invoice id=' + inv.id); continue; } const lines = inv['invoice-lines'] || []; const hasLinkedPo = lines.some(line => (line['po-number'] && String(line['po-number']).trim() !== '') || (line['order-header-num'] && String(line['order-header-num']).trim() !== '')); if (hasLinkedPo) { continue; } qualifyingCount++; } return { qualifyingCount };

const ws = $context.variables.windowStart; const we = $context.variables.windowEnd; const url = `https://uipath-test.coupahost.com/invoices?q%5Binvoice_date_gteq%5D=${ws}&q%5Binvoice_date_lteq%5D=${we}&q%5Bstatus_eq%5D=draft`; return { coupaFilteredUrl: url };

const count = $context.variables.qualifyingCount; const url = $context.variables.coupaFilteredUrl; const msg = `${count} invoices from the last seven days have no purchase order linked. An invoice without a linked PO cannot be matched or paid under our no-PO-no-pay policy, and payment to the supplier stalls until it is fixed. Please make sure a purchase order exists for these invoices and is correctly linked to each one. Open the list in Coupa: ${url}`; return { slackMessageBody: msg };
